simulation.method: Real candidate pools from the database for 7 synthetic profiles (UI role buttons + popular-skill buttons). Each simulation adds one missing skill (every skill present in the pool) or a greedy plan's skill set, then compares Simulator.ranks_with/scores_with against scorer.rank_pool on the extended profile. A simulation agrees when the whole rank order is identical and every score is within 1e-12.

local.method: 20 fixed queries; one untimed warm-up pass (wakes the host, fills the query-embedding cache), then n timed sequential requests spaced 2.1 s apart from one client. Round trip = client wall time for the HTTP request; server = the API's own took_ms (embedding lookup + hybrid SQL). Cached query embeddings, so the embedding API's latency is not included.
